name: environment-promotion-drift-reporter
description: Reports whether production matches what actually passed testing in the promotion chain, comparing image tags and commit SHAs across dev, staging, and prod to catch promotion drift. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (Amazon ECS MCP Server and a custom CI MCP) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on WED at 07:00 UTC
